arm_length.source: Förster 2015, 'System Identification of the Crazyflie 2.0 Nano Quadrocopter', BSc thesis, ETH Zurich (IDSC-RD-MDH-04), pp. 17 and 20, doi:10.3929/ethz-b-000214143 ; Crazyflie firmware platform_defaults_cf2.h @ f6e0f0a, https://github.com/bitcraze/crazyflie-firmware/blob/f6e0f0a3b526861328caf3296a7ecf00bb915d39/src/platform/interface/platform_defaults_cf2.h

rotor_b1.source: Förster 2015, Appendix A p. 57 and Sec. 3.3.2 p. 28 (second series, recommended)

motor_pole.source: Förster 2015, Sec. 3.4.4 eq. (3.16)-(3.17) p. 34 and Appendix A p. 57

f_max.source: derived: thrust map at cmd = 65535 (Förster App. A); consistent with Förster Sec. 3.3.1 p. 27

kaero_xy.source: Förster 2015, Appendix A p. 57 'Drag Coefficients, Simple Model' (Sec. 4 p. 39 for the model)

g.source: MuJoCo default gravity (0 0 -9.81), used so the MuJoCo check shares it

h1.gate: H1 holds, against the ring: ring worse than the best other arm
h1.h1_rule: Amendment 4: H1 holds if the within-seed arm-permutation p for ring minus best other < 0.05 (the pre-registered bootstrap CI is reported as gate_preregistered_ci)
